#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ─── CONFIG ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
: "${FREEINFERENCE_API_KEY:?Set FREEINFERENCE_API_KEY to your hyi- key}"
FI_SESSION_JWT="${FI_SESSION_JWT:-}" # Optional: Bearer eyJ... from browser DevTools for /user/* routes
BASE="https://freeinference.org"
DATA_BASE="https://data.freeinference.org"
OUT="/tmp/fi_orthogonal/out"
SESSION_ID="probe-$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$OUT"

# Site bans fake/missing user agents (banner 2026-07-30). Use a real browser UA everywhere.
UA="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"

log() { printf '\n[%s] %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*"; }

# Data-plane helper (/v1/* and /anthropic/* use hyi-... API key)
req_v1() {
  curl -sS --compressed -A "$UA" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${FREEINFERENCE_API_KEY}" \
    -H "X-Session-ID: ${SESSION_ID}" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" "$@"
}

# Control-plane helper (/user/* uses session JWT if set, otherwise falls back to API key to show 401 vs 200 split)
req_user() {
  local tok="${FI_SESSION_JWT:-$FREEINFERENCE_API_KEY}"
  curl -sS --compressed -A "$UA" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${tok}" \
    -H "Accept: application/json" "$@"
}

# ─── 1. CONTROL-PLANE, SITE-UPDATES & ULID CHRONOMETRY ───────────────────
log "1. Probing /site-updates, /auth/accounts, /user/me, /user/usage, /user/api-keys/all"
curl -sS --compressed -A "$UA" -H "Accept: application/json" "${BASE}/site-updates" | tee "$OUT/site_updates.json" || true
req_user "${BASE}/auth/accounts" | tee "$OUT/accounts.json" || true
req_user "${BASE}/user/me" | tee "$OUT/me.json" || true
req_user "${BASE}/user/usage?period=today" | tee "$OUT/usage.json" || true
req_user "${BASE}/user/api-keys/all" | tee "$OUT/api_keys_all.json" || true

if [[ -n "$FI_SESSION_JWT" ]]; then
  log "1b. Decoding Crockford Base32 ULIDs (sub, sid, jti) from FI_SESSION_JWT"
  python3 - "$FI_SESSION_JWT" << 'PYEOF' | tee "$OUT/jwt_ulids.json"
import base64, datetime, json, sys
CROCKFORD = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
def ulid_ts(u: str):
    s = u.split("_")[-1]
    if len(s) < 10 or any(c not in CROCKFORD for c in s[:10]): return None
    ms = 0
    for c in s[:10]: ms = ms * 32 + CROCKFORD.index(c)
    return {"id": u, "epoch_ms": ms, "utc": datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ms/1000, tz=datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
parts = sys.argv[1].split(".")
if len(parts) >= 2:
    p = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(parts[1] + "==").decode())
    print(json.dumps({"role": p.get("role"), "ttl_s": int(p.get("exp",0)) - int(p.get("iat",0)), "ulids": {k: ulid_ts(str(p.get(k,""))) for k in ("sub","sid","jti")}}, indent=2))
PYEOF
fi

# ─── 2. /v1/models HEADER POLYMORPHISM & ROUTE BOUNDARIES ────────────────
log "2. Testing /v1/models schema switch (OpenAI default vs Anthropic-Version: 2023-06-01)"
req_v1 "${BASE}/v1/models" > "$OUT/models_openai.json"
curl -sS --compressed -A "$UA" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${FREEINFERENCE_API_KEY}" \
  -H "Anthropic-Version: 2023-06-01" \
  "${BASE}/v1/models" > "$OUT/models_anthropic.json" || true

jq -r '.data[].id' "$OUT/models_openai.json" 2>/dev/null | tee "$OUT/model_ids.txt" || true

log "2a. Diffing OpenAI vs Anthropic model lists (polymorphism wire diff)"
python3 - "$OUT/models_openai.json" "$OUT/models_anthropic.json" << 'PYEOF' | tee "$OUT/models_polymorphism_diff.json"
import json, sys
def load(p):
    raw = open(p).read().strip()
    try: return json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
    except Exception: return {}
o, a = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
oai = {m["id"] for m in o.get("data", [])}
anth = {m["id"] for m in a.get("data", [])}
print(json.dumps({
    "openai_schema_count": len(oai),
    "anthropic_schema_count": len(anth),
    "only_in_openai_schema": sorted(oai - anth),
    "only_in_anthropic_schema": sorted(anth - oai),
    "anthropic_sample": (a.get("data") or [{}])[0],
}, indent=2))
PYEOF

log "2b. Testing doc-label 'glm-5.3' (404) vs actual ID 'glm-5.3-flash' (200) vs 'bge-m3' on chat route (404)"
req_v1 -X POST "${BASE}/v1/chat/completions" \
  -d '{"model":"glm-5.3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"max_tokens":1}' | tee "$OUT/glm53_doclabel.json" || true
req_v1 -X POST "${BASE}/v1/chat/completions" \
  -d '{"model":"glm-5.3-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"max_tokens":1}' | tee "$OUT/glm53_flash.json" || true
req_v1 -X POST "${BASE}/v1/chat/completions" \
  -d '{"model":"bge-m3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"max_tokens":1}' | tee "$OUT/bgem3_chat_reject.json" || true
req_v1 -X POST "${BASE}/v1/embeddings" \
  -d '{"model":"bge-m3","input":"ping"}' | jq '{object, model, dim: (.data[0].embedding | length)}' | tee "$OUT/bgem3_embed_ok.json" || true

# ─── 3. ANTHROPIC MESSAGES WIRE TRANSLATOR (/anthropic/v1/messages) ──────
log "3. Probing Anthropic wire translator (/anthropic/v1/messages with anthropic-version: 2023-06-01)"
curl -sS --compressed -A "$UA" -X POST "${BASE}/anthropic/v1/messages" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${FREEINFERENCE_API_KEY}" \
  -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
  -H "X-Session-ID: ${SESSION_ID}" \
  -d '{"model":"minimax-m3","max_tokens":16,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say ok."}]}' | tee "$OUT/anthropic_minimax.json" || true

# ─── 4. X-REASONING-PASSTHROUGH & ECHOED X-REQUEST-ID WIRE DIFF ──────────

# 2026-10-26 — FreeInference Orthogonal Probe (Build 4b80416 recon)

Probe script: `/tmp/fi_orthogonal/probe.sh` · Raw outputs: `/tmp/fi_orthogonal/out/`
Session: `probe-20261026-083426Z` · All HTTP observed live.

## Findings

| # | Probe | Result | Anomaly / Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `/site-updates` | 200 | Banner: "fake user agent will be banned" (2026-07-30). Onboarding paused at capacity (2026-08-11). **Control plane treats missing UA as a ban-worthy signal — always send a real UA string.** |
| 1 | `/auth/accounts` | 200 | `{active_user_id:null, accounts:[], max_accounts:5}` with bare API key — leaks **max_accounts:5** plan limit without auth. |
| 1 | `/user/me`, `/user/usage`, `/user/api-keys/all`, `/user/recent-requests` | 401 | Confirmed hard split: data-plane (`hyi-` key) works, control-plane (`/user/*`) requires a **session JWT** (browser DevTools) — not obtainable from API key. ULID chronometry script needs that JWT; skipped. |
| 2 | `/v1/models` polymorphism | 200 both | Header-switch confirmed: default → OpenAI `list` schema (6 models incl. `bge-m3`); `Anthropic-Version: 2023-06-01` → Anthropic schema (`display_name`, `created_at` epoch-0, `has_more`). **Anthropic models list omits `bge-m3`** (5 vs 6) — embed model hidden from that schema. All `created_at` = epoch 0 (placeholder, not real registration dates). |
| 2b | Model ID boundaries | ✓ | `glm-5.3` (doc label) → 404; `glm-5.3-flash` → 200; `bge-m3` on chat → 404, on `/v1/embeddings` → 200, dim=1024, served as `BAAI/bge-m3`. Route-boundary enforcement is correct. glm-5.3-flash response carried `reasoning_content` even at max_tokens=1 (finish=length) — reasoning field appears on the wire regardless of budget. |
| 3 | `/anthropic/v1/messages` | 200 | Wire translator LIVE — but **model mismatch**: requested `minimax-m3`, served `qwen3.6-35b` (same silent-fallback class as the model-identity chain anomaly). `usage` omits cache fields entirely on this wire. |
| 4 | `X-Reasoning-Passthrough: false` | no-op | Message keys identical (`role`,`content`), usage identical (9 completion tokens both). On this model/prompt the header produced **no observable wire diff**. `X-Request-ID` echoed back verbatim in response headers (confirmed `req-…-on`). CF NEL/report-to telemetry headers present. |
| 5 | `/user/recent-requests` audit | n/a | Blocked by 401 — provider split + 16-token alignment audit requires session JWT. `/user/api-keys/all` also 401 (155B error envelope). |
| 6 | `data.freeinference.org/api/dashboard` | empty | `/api/dashboard` returned 0 bytes. **BUT `/api/history?hours=2` returned 596KB of live telemetry, NO AUTH** (596,498B `openinfra_history.json`) — see §Fleet below. |

## Confirmed contract updates vs estate doctrine

1. **New model in catalog**: `minimax-m3.1-flash` — not in estate models.yml yet. Candidate for mimetite catalog regen.
2. **Embeddings route exists**: `/v1/embeddings` with `BAAI/bge-m3` (dim 1024) — estate has no embeddings consumer wired.
3. **Anthropic wire translator live** at `/anthropic/v1/messages` — usable for Claude-compatible clients, but **silent model fallback applies** (minimax-m3 → qwen3.6-35b). Never trust requested==served.
4. **User-agent doctrine**: site explicitly bans fake UAs; keep real UA on all FI traffic.
5. **Control plane is JWT-gated** — probes needing `/user/*` telemetry require `FI_SESSION_JWT` from browser DevTools.

## Full catalog (from models_openai.json — 3,205B, never trust doc labels)

| id | owned_by | quant | ctx | max_out | pricing in/out per-M | modalities | sampling params | features |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| glm-5.3-flash | zai | fp8 | 1M | 131k | 0.3/1.0, cache-read 0.06 | text,image | max_tokens, reasoning_effort, stop, stream, temperature, thinking, tool_stream, top_p | tools, json_mode, structured_outputs |
| minimax-m3 | minimax | bf16 | 1.05M | 131k | 0.5/2.0, cache-read 0.3 | text,image,video | (no reasoning_effort) + thinking | tools, json_mode, structured_outputs |
| qwen3.6-35b | vllm | mixed | 262k | **8k** | 0.08/0.28, cache-read 0.01 | text,image,video | no thinking/reasoning params at all | tools, json_mode, structured_outputs |
| deepseek-v4-flash | sglang | none | 1M | **393k** | 0.44/1.32, cache-read 0.014 | text | reasoning_effort + thinking | tools, json_mode, structured_outputs |
| minimax-m3.1-flash | minimax | bf16 | 1M | 256k | 0.2/0.8, cache-read 0.02, **cache-write 0.2** | text,image | max_tokens, temperature, top_p only | tools only (no json_mode) |
| bge-m3 | sglang | fp16 | 8k | — | 0/0 (free) | text→embedding | none | embeddings |

Notable: `qwen3.6-35b` max_output is only **8k tokens** — reasoning-budget starvation risk is 3× tighter than assumed (estate doctrine says max_tokens ≥ 2500 with reasoning on; qwen has no reasoning params but 8k ceiling still bites long outputs). `deepseek-v4-flash` has the largest output ceiling (393k). Cache-write is only billed on minimax-m3.1-flash. All `created` timestamps identical (1792967825 = 2026-10-25T16:37:05Z — catalog regenerated yesterday, epoch-0 in Anthropic schema is a placeholder).

## Fleet telemetry (openinfra_history.json — UNAUTHENTICATED, 596KB, 60s grain, ~2h window)

**FreeInference's entire infrastructure control plane is readable without any auth** via `GET https://data.freeinference.org/api/history?hours=2`. Contents (427 GPU rows, 305 sglang rows, 183 cpu rows):

**Nodes:** `h200a` (4× H200), `rtx6000b` (2× RTX 6000 Blackwell), `spark2` (1× NVIDIA Spark — likely DGX Spark).

**Server↔GPU mapping (provenance ground truth):**
| SGLang server | Node | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `h200a-glm53-flash` | h200a | run=3, 535 tps, TTFT 1.23s, cache_hit 72.8%, spec_accept_len 2.47 |
| `h200a-replica-a` | h200a | **hicache host FULL: 25.28GB/25.28GB**, cached-prefill 25.7k tps, cache_hit 97.6%, spec_len 3.3 |
| `rtx6000b-qwen36` | rtx6000b | run=1, 214 tps, TTFT 0.059s, cache_hit 6.9% |
| `rtx6000b-bge-m3` | rtx6000b | idle (0 tps), TTFT 0.0096s |
| `spark2-qwen36-nvfp4` | spark2 | idle, TTFT 0.97s, cache_hit 45% |

**Anomalies in telemetry:**
- **rtx6000b:0 thermal pressure: median 84°C, max 86°C** at 300W — sustained near-throttle. rtx6000b:1 cooler (77°C).
- **h200a:2/3 idle (0% util) while :0/:1 at 100%** — replicas present but traffic concentrated; mem ~98% on all 4 (weights resident).
- `spark2` reports `memory_pct: null`, no tensor/dram/pcie metrics — DCGM exporter partially broken on that node (GPU missing from server-name mapping too; `spark2-qwen36-nvfp4` runs but GPU row can't be attributed).
- `minimax-m3` and `minimax-m3.1-flash` have **no visible SGLang server** in the window — Minimax traffic either routed off-fleet or the server was down/batched elsewhere. Yet probe 2b/3 showed minimax-m3 requests "served" (translator silently gave qwen) — consistent with **no live minimax backend**.
- `spec_accept_length ~2.5-3.3` on glm/qwen — speculative decoding active with modest acceptance.
- `from_cache: false`, `grain_ms: 60000` — live pull, 1-minute grain.
- Queue depths all 0, `http_error_per_min` 0 across window — no observed saturation at 08:19Z snapshot.

**Doctrine implication:** the ROUTE CONTRACT anomaly class (front door alive, exec lane dead) now has a third leg: **fleet telemetry is the best "is the backend really there" signal** — `data.freeinference.org/api/history` proves which models have live backends regardless of what the catalog advertises. Poll it before trusting any model in the catalog.

Contents at probe time (fleet: **healthy**, 4 nodes / 11 GPUs / 7 online, 7 SGLang servers / 5 online, 2,277W total, avg 60.6°C, 3 running reqs, queue 0):

**Nodes:** `h200a` (4× H200), `rtx6000b` (2× RTX 6000 Blackwell), `spark2` (NVIDIA Spark — DCGM metrics partial: `memory_pct`/tensor/dram/pcie all `null`).

**Server↔GPU mapping (provenance ground truth):**
| SGLang server | Node | Observed |
|---|---|---|
| `h200a-glm53-flash` | h200a | up to 535 tps, TTFT 0.44–1.23s, cache_hit 73–97%, spec_accept_len 2.5–3.7 |

| `spark2-qwen36-nvfp4` | spark2 | idle, TTFT ~0.96s, cache_hit ~41–45% |

**Anomalies in telemetry:**
- **rtx6000b:0 thermal pressure: median 84°C, max 86°C** at ~300W — sustained near-throttle; spikes to 81–83°C seen in later windows.
- **H200 pair load-balances unevenly**: `:0/:1` vs `:2/:3` swap between 100% and 0% util across the window (replicas alternate), all 4 at ~98% mem (weights resident).

- Dashboard `kpis` counts 11 GPUs / 7 servers while history shows 7 GPUs / 5 servers — **dashboard includes offline/deregistered hardware in totals** (nodes_online 3 of 4, gpus_online 7 of 11).

**Doctrine implication:** the ROUTE CONTRACT anomaly class (front door alive, exec lane dead) now has a third leg: **fleet telemetry is the best "is the backend really there" signal** — `openinfra.freeinference.org/api/dashboard` + `/api/history` prove which models have live backends regardless of what the catalog advertises.
